asset_manifest.pose: dino_bones_paleontologist_4 (Latino male grad student, black aviators) is pointing at a series of tracks on a golden-yellow sandbar.

visual_notes.ichnology: Large, deeply impressed quadrupedal tracks. The weight of the large head-crest is reflected in very deep manual (hand) impressions. Each toe tip ends in a clean, sharp puncture hole in the damp sand.
visual_notes.ground: Golden yellow fluvial sand with iron-oxide red streaks and willow-like shrubs in the background.
